# Canvas UI

> An open source library of creative, framework-agnostic components drawn on canvas. Most of the library is built on the experimental html-in-canvas API, which lets WebGL effects run over live, fully interactive HTML. Components ship as source through a shadcn-compatible registry for React, Solid, Preact, Vue, Svelte, Angular, and vanilla JS.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://canvasui.dev/docs): What Canvas UI is, how it works, and browser support
- [Installation](https://canvasui.dev/docs/installation): Requirements, the shadcn CLI, and manual setup
- [MCP Server](https://canvasui.dev/docs/mcp): Use the registry with the shadcn MCP server so AI assistants can browse and install components
- [Playground](https://canvasui.dev/playground): Try every component on a mock landing page with live controls

## Components

- [Asciify](https://canvasui.dev/docs/components/asciify): A soft lens that follows the cursor and redraws live HTML beneath it as ascii characters
- [Bend](https://canvasui.dev/docs/components/bend): Folds the top and bottom of live HTML over straight virtual edges, like scrolling on the face of a cube
- [Blaze](https://canvasui.dev/docs/components/blaze): Fire sparks, smoke, and heat distortion rising over live HTML
- [Bubble](https://canvasui.dev/docs/components/bubble): A glassy droplet that trails the cursor as blending metaballs and refracts the live page beneath it
- [Cloth](https://canvasui.dev/docs/components/cloth): Hangs live HTML on a piece of fabric rippling in the wind, with softly lit folds; cursor strokes send waves across the cloth
- [Clouds](https://canvasui.dev/docs/components/clouds): Theme-aware mist that blurs and refracts live HTML, parted by cursor wind
- [Dithered Object](https://canvasui.dev/docs/components/dithered-object): Any GLB/glTF model floating in a studio scene, rendered through a 1-bit Bayer dither (three.js)
- [Droplets](https://canvasui.dev/docs/components/droplets): Rain droplets that run down the screen and refract live HTML
- [Frost](https://canvasui.dev/docs/components/frost): A frozen pane of ice over live HTML that melts under the cursor and refreezes, with refraction and frost grain
- [Glass](https://canvasui.dev/docs/components/glass): A cursor-following glass lens that refracts live HTML and zooms in on targets like a crystal ball
- [Glass Object](https://canvasui.dev/docs/components/glass-object): Turns any 3D model, SVG, or image into floating liquid glass with real refraction, dispersion, and frost
- [Glitch](https://canvasui.dev/docs/components/glitch): Broadcast glitch bursts that tear live HTML into shifted slices with RGB splits, corrupted blocks, and analog noise
- [Grid](https://canvasui.dev/docs/components/grid): 3D tiles that ripple in staggered waves around the cursor over live HTML
- [Hex Float](https://canvasui.dev/docs/components/hex-float): Live HTML on shiny floating hex tiles with perspective tilt and a fluid-driven reading window around the cursor
- [Laser](https://canvasui.dev/docs/components/laser): A laser beam near the bottom of the viewport that reveals live HTML from behind it on scroll
- [Liquid](https://canvasui.dev/docs/components/liquid): A pointer-driven WebGL fluid simulation that runs over live HTML
- [Magnify](https://canvasui.dev/docs/components/magnify): A sci-fi scanner lens that magnifies live HTML inside a HUD reticle, with click ripples that bend the page
- [Particle Object](https://canvasui.dev/docs/components/particle-object): Rebuilds any GLB/glTF model, SVG, or image as a cloud of particles that the cursor pushes, swirls, and springs back into shape
- [Particle Reveal](https://canvasui.dev/docs/components/particle-reveal): Renders live HTML as fine readable particles that merge into the crisp UI around the cursor, with chromatic aberration and edge bending
- [Particle Scroll](https://canvasui.dev/docs/components/particle-scroll): Dissolves live HTML below a chosen line into fine sand particles that reassemble on scroll
- [Peel](https://canvasui.dev/docs/components/peel): Peels live HTML back from a chosen edge on hover, curling it in 3D to reveal a second layer underneath
- [Retro Dither](https://canvasui.dev/docs/components/retro-dither): A retro dither lens that pixelates live HTML around the cursor
- [Ripple](https://canvasui.dev/docs/components/ripple): Water ripples that spread from every click and refract live HTML like a pond surface
- [Shatter](https://canvasui.dev/docs/components/shatter): Breaks live HTML into 3D glass shards that lift, float, and refract around the cursor, with perspective and soft shadows
- [VHS](https://canvasui.dev/docs/components/vhs): Worn tape playback with wave, head-switching noise, chroma bleed, and grain over live HTML

## Registry

- [Registry index](https://canvasui.dev/r/registry.json): shadcn-compatible registry index
- Install with: npx shadcn@latest add @canvas-ui/liquid-react (also liquid-solid, liquid-preact, liquid-vue, liquid-svelte, liquid-angular, liquid-vanilla)
- @canvas-ui is a trusted shadcn registry, so no components.json configuration is needed

## Notes

- Components that use html-in-canvas currently require Chrome with the chrome://flags/#canvas-draw-element flag enabled
- Docs pages have a "Copy as Markdown" button for AI-friendly content
- License: MIT + Commons Clause (free to use in products; do not resell or redistribute the components themselves)
